title: apocynum androsaemifolium subsp. pumilum
intro: Apocynum androsaemifolium subsp. pumilum, commonly known as Dogbane or Sidebells Dogbane, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dogbane family Apocynaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including hypertension, diabetes, and inflammation, due to its health benefits in improving cardiovascular function and regulating blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Apocynum androsaemifolium subsp. pumilum include vasorelaxation, diuretic, and hypoglycemic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardenolides, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
